focus: §3.2.1 scaled dot-product attention: editable small Q, K, and V; show scores, softmax weights, and W·V; include a scaling toggle; explore equal scores and a dominant score; verify rows sum to 1.
audience: Engineering undergraduate who knows vectors and matrix multiplication
excerpt: 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention. The input consists of queries and keys of dimension d_k, and values of dimension d_v. We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by sqrt(d_k), and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values. Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))V. The scaling prevents large dot products from pushing the softmax into regions with extremely small gradients.
